prometheus_module_path.description: Path (relative to nginx root) to the Prometheus module .so file

error_log_level.description: Global logging level: debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per worker process

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (e.g., 'auto', '1', '4'). Set to 'auto' for CPU-core autodetection.

keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for keep-alive connections to the backend

sendfile.description: Enable or disable kernel zero-copy sendfile optimization

prometheus_port.description: Port on which the Prometheus metrics endpoint (/metrics) is exposed

prometheus_server_name.description: Server name (hostname) for the internal Prometheus metrics server block

sites.description: List of upstream application server blocks to proxy/load balance to (besides the internal /metrics server)

name.description: Server name (domain) for this virtual host

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl=true)

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl=true)

root.description: Document root directory for static content

index.description: Index files to try in order (e.g., ['index.html', 'index.htm'])

return.description: Immediate HTTP response (for redirects or static responses)

body.description: Optional redirect URL or response body

description.description: Human-readable description of this site (used in template comments)
